boundary.design: Single documented synchronous boundary: `runRouteDecisionThroughProducer(input, layer = DefaultRouteDecisionLayer)` builds `RouteDecisionProducer.use((producer) => producer.decide(input))` and returns `Effect.runSync(Effect.provide(program, layer))`. `DefaultRouteDecisionLayer` is the core producer's live Layer created once at module scope, so no per-call Layer allocation; there is no ambient provider and no global mutable state. `routeRuntimeRequest(input, options?: RouteRuntimeRequestOptions)` delegates through it; `options.routeDecisionLayer` is the only injectable seam (used by the wiring test).
